own_solution.law: Normal-incidence acoustic transmission: p_t = 2 Z2/(Z1+Z2) sqrt(2 Z1 I) = sqrt(2 Z2 * T_I * I), Z = rho c

notes: Authors' route (intensity transmission coefficient, p_t = sqrt(2 Z2 I_t)) is equivalent to my pressure-coefficient route; base 6.28424 Pa agrees. Certified R answers check: 6.28424*sqrt(1.25) = 7.02599, *sqrt(1.5) = 7.69659, *sqrt(1.75) = 8.31326 Pa. Frequency is C as I had it. Minimal pairs TA783/TCC99 and TEFDB/T9B4F both state 0.006 W/m^2 and differ only in attachment (second loudspeaker; earlier trial); TF89B and TBD48 are declared numeral-free twins. Minor tense difference between T9B4F ('was measured') and TCC99 ('is measured') is wording only. The D status of the second loudspeaker relies on the scene reading that its sound, aimed at the boathouse wall, does not reach the water surface as part of the incident plane wave; that is the natural reading given 'The wave comes from a first loudspeaker', so I do not flag it.
